# Hospio Solutions

> Hospio Solutions is a hospitality-focused digital marketing and commercial services partner based in Bali, Indonesia.

## Official website
- https://www.hospiosolutions.com/
- https://www.hospiosolutions.com/services
- https://www.hospiosolutions.com/about-us
- https://www.hospiosolutions.com/contact
- https://www.hospiosolutions.com/blog

## Company overview
Hospio Solutions (legal business name shown on the website: Nava Hospio Solution) is based in Bali, Indonesia. Its website describes a focus on digital advertising, e-commerce optimisation, social media, branding, and commercial support for hospitality businesses.

## Industries served
- Hotels
- Resorts
- Villas
- Hospitality businesses

## Services described on the website
- Commercial Partner: sales, marketing, revenue and reservation support for hotels and villas.
- Digital Marketing: digital advertising and online exposure strategies. The website names Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and OTA media including BNSA and TravelAds.
- Social Media Management: social media content and management for hospitality properties.
- E-commerce optimisation and branding are also referenced in the website's service overview.

## Geographic focus
Hospio Solutions is based in Bali, Indonesia. Its stated market direction includes Bali, the wider Indonesian market, and international clients.
